source: api.guildwars2.com /v2/recipes, /v2/items (measured 2026-08-16). The link an entry needs is GET /v2/items/:id details.recipe_id, returned for an item whose details.type is Unlock and details.unlock_type is CraftingRecipe. No file under ref/ carries it, so an entry is added by running that lookup against a candidate sheet item id. tools/VendorOfferUpdater runs the same lookup in Gw2ApiHelper.ResolveRecipeSheetRecipeIdAsync, and 18 offers in ref/vendor_offers.json already carry the pair it resolved.

items.note: GET /v2/recipes/13853 flags == ["LearnedFromItem"]; GET /v2/items/96274 details.recipe_id == 13853. ref/vendor_offers.json already carries multiple pure-coin (5000 copper) vendor offers for item 96274 (Researcher, Peddler, Daxx, Archaeologist, Winn Schwartzmeier, Merchant (Mori Village), Elder (merchant)), so this entry is priceable/exercisable end-to-end today, not just wired.
